saw_lines: People buying personal growth courses pick the teacher before the topic, so they need to see the person speaking.
So the sale is decided in the first line, while the viewer still wonders if this teacher is right for them.
Your 4 of 27 ads use claim words like clinically, cure and guaranteed results, so swap each one for what students noticed in their own lives, which keeps your reach intact.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: Four of your 27 ads use claim words like clinically, cure and guaranteed results, which limit reach. Replace each claim with what students noticed in their first week, and test those lines inside three new versions of your oldest winner.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a cold buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Open the next batch with one real count, like review total or orders shipped, placed in the first line.
0 of 27 ads mention an offer or discount, so a first time viewer has no reason to act today. Give new buyers one reason to act, such as a first enrolment offer, and lead three new ads with it.

25 ads have run 60+ days, so those angles already hold attention. Build three variations of your oldest winner, the first dates clip from March 2025, keeping its opening line and changing the closing call to action.
